title: Mankato, MN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Mankato, MN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Mankato is a city in MN with a population of 43,000. Southern Minnesota college town with Minnesota State University and the Minnesota River. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.8.
